test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Five persons S, T, R, U and W are sitting in a straight line facing north. S is second to the left of T. R is to the immediate right of T. U is not sitting at any end. W is not an immediate neighbor of S. Who is sitting in the middle ?
solution: Given: Five persons S, T, R, U and W are sitting in a straight line facing north. 1) S is second to the left of T. 2) R is to the immediate right of T.
